Bedrijfsomschrijving 

This company (re)packages and stores frozen and chilled food products for numerous European businesses. They do this in a customized way for each client. By 2027, the company aims to have more than 300 employees working together on 25,000 unique packaging assignments.

Working at this company means working in a respectful environment where strong connection between employees and dedication to the work go hand in hand.

You oversee the production process and, together with your team, ensure smooth day-to-day operations.

 
• 
You monitor the operation of 3 automatic packaging machines

 
• 
You manage 3 operators and 2 forklift drivers and provide guidance throughout their work

 
• 
You actively work on the machines yourself and step in wherever needed

 
• 
You set up, monitor, and adjust the packaging machines

 
• 
During production, you monitor quality, safety, efficiency, and production planning

 
• 
You carry out checks on products and packaging

 
• 
You identify malfunctions and deviations and resolve them yourself whenever possible

 
• 
You ensure an efficient distribution of tasks and clear communication within the team

 
• 
You are the first point of contact for employees on the production floor

Do you know automatic packaging lines inside out, enjoy taking a hands-on approach, and at the same time know how to keep an overview of both your team and the production process? Then this Team Leader position could be a great fit for you.

 
• 
Experience working with an automatic packaging line is essential

 
• 
You have strong technical insight and a hands-on mentality

 
• 
Experience with CPS, multihead weighers, checkweighers, metal detection systems and/or automatic stackers is an advantage

 
• 
Experience managing or coordinating a team is an asset

 
• 
You have natural leadership skills and the maturity required to take responsibility

 
• 
You have good organisational and communication skills

 
• 
You communicate very well in Dutch and English and have a basic knowledge of French. This is essential, as you will be managing operators and forklift drivers who speak Dutch, English, or French

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

This company (re)packages and stores frozen and chilled food products for numerous European businesses. They do this in a customized way for each client. By 2027, the company aims to have more than 300 employees working together on 25,000 unique packaging assignments.

Working at this company means working in a respectful environment where strong connection between employees and dedication to the work go hand in hand.

You are a key point of contact on the work floor and maintain an overview of the day-to-day logistics operations. At the same time, you take an active, hands-on role in the work yourself.

 
• 
You operate a forklift, reach truck and pallet truck and assist wherever needed.

 
• 
You maintain an overview of the logistics operations and organise the work to ensure everything runs smoothly.

 
• 
You guide and supervise colleagues in a clear and positive manner.

 
• 
You monitor safety, quality and the correct execution of all activities.

 
• 
You accurately scan labels and storage locations and ensure that all movements of goods are correctly registered.

 
• 
When deviations or unexpected situations occur, you respond quickly and take a practical approach to finding solutions.

 
• 
As a key point of contact on the work floor, you contribute to effective teamwork and cooperation.

 
• 
You help ensure that logistics operations are carried out efficiently and in an organised manner.

Ready to take responsibility, support your team and get the job done? You can read below what we are looking for.

 
• 
You have experience in a logistics or warehouse environment and are familiar with day-to-day warehouse operations.

 
• 
You have experience supervising, guiding or coordinating employees.

 
• 
Working hands-on alongside the team is an important part of this position and is something you are comfortable with.

 
• 
You have practical experience operating a forklift and/or reach truck and hold the required certificates.

 
• 
Experience with a pallet truck is an advantage, but not a requirement.

 
• 
You are able to maintain an overview, set priorities and adapt quickly when schedules or circumstances change.

 
• 
You communicate clearly with colleagues and are able to guide employees in a positive manner.

 
• 
You actively monitor safety and quality on the work floor.

 
• 
You communicate well in Dutch and English and have a basic knowledge of French. This is important because you will be supervising logistics employees who speak Dutch, English or French.

Our client, Legend Biotech, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company bringing the innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the Legend Biotech team makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members

Jobomschrijving

As a Production Team Lead, you will be responsible for the daily production of personalized cell therapies for both clinical and commercial use in a sterile cGMP environment. You will coordinate the different units within the CAR-T process and ensure that all activities are carried out safely and in full compliance with cGMP requirements — while steering and organizing the operations from your office-based workspace, keeping a strong overview of the production flow and acting as the central point of coordination for the team.

If you don't have prior leadership experience yet, that is also okay. If you have solid GMP  experience (ideally in production or close to production) and you naturally take ownership, coordinate smoothly, and feel comfortable guiding others, we strongly encourage you to apply.

Responsibilities:
	
• Coordinate and supervise operational units within the CAR-T manufacturing process, including component preparation, production support, CAR-T processing, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.	
• Act as the first point of contact for production issues and collaborate closely with Manufacturing Operations, QC IPC, Quality, Facilities & Engineering, MS&T/Manufacturing Excellence, Training, Planning, and Supply Chain.	
• Serve as a domain expert for Quality and Operations in cGMP environments and play a key role during GMP inspections and external audits.	
• Manage all quality-related production aspects, including procedures, work instructions, logbooks, transfer forms, batch record review and release, and overall cGMP compliance.	
• Coordinate quality system activities such as Change Controls, Deviations/Events, and CAPA.	
• Ensure proper training of team members and promote a culture of continuous learning.	
• Drive operational excellence by initiating improvements that increase efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance overall quality.

Who we are looking for: 
	
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Science, Bio-Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent through experience.	
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a GMP environment, preferably in biotech or biopharma. 	
• Experience in people management, or with relatable coordinating activities such as training, coaching, ... .	
• Solid knowledge of cGMP regulations and cleanroom operations; familiarity with Microsoft Office is required, and experience with MES/EBR is a plus.	
• Strong communication and organizational skills. You don’t need formal leadership experience, but you do show natural leadership qualities:	
• you take ownership	
• you guide and support others confidently	
• you keep oversight and work in a structured way	
• Positive, flexible, and capable of prioritizing, multitasking, and solving problems effectively, with strong attention to detail.	
• Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.
They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Are you ready for a new challenge where your expertise can truly make a difference?

If you have a Scientific degree and experience in Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or related field, this is your opportunity to be part of something bigger than yourself. As an Operations Expert, you'll play a key role in manufacturing advanced cell therapies that are transforming cancer treatment and giving patients new hope.

Every day, your work will directly contribute to delivering life-changing therapies to patients facing serious diseases. Join a passionate team united by a shared purpose: creating innovative treatments and improving lives around the world.

Your key responsibilities:
	
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.	
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.	
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.	
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.	
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.	
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste.

Who we are looking for:
	
• You have obtained at least a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.	
• Cell experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 	
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.	
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.	
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.	
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.	
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.	
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

Join our team as a Warehouse & Operations Associate and contribute to a mission that truly makes a difference in the fight against life-threatening diseases such as bloodcancer. 

In this role, you will be part of a supportive and collaborative environment within a leading global pharmaceutical company.

As a Warehouse & Operations Associate, your responsibilities will primarily focus on operational warehouse activities with an accurate administrative follow-up. 
	
• Responsible for inbound and outbound warehouse activities in a GMP-regulated environment.	
• Receive, handle and store cryopreserved blood samples (cells) from cancer patients, which serve as the critical starting material for the manufacturing process.	
• Manage inventory, warehouse materials and internal material requests to support other departments.	
• Use SAP to process warehouse transactions and ensure accurate inventory records.	
• Maintain documentation, traceability and compliance with GMP and quality requirements.	
• Collaborate closely with other departments to support smooth day-to-day activities.

	
• You have experience in logistics, warehousing, or operational environments, or you are eager to learn and develop yourself in this field.	
• You work accurately, pay close attention to detail, and follow procedures to ensure quality, compliance, and safety.	
• You are reliable, proactive, and take ownership of your responsibilities.	
• You enjoy working in a team and collaborate effectively with colleagues across different departments.	
• You communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.	
• You can commute independently to the site and are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Packaging Meat - 2-Shift - Oudenaarde  

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

We are looking for Meat Production Workers for a growing food company!

The company processes ham and packages it for various supermarket chains.

The job is not physically demanding!

Early shift: 5:00 a.m.–1:30 p.m.

Late shift: 1:30 p.m.–10:00 p.m.

You get a half-hour break.

PROFIEL

What are your responsibilities?

• As a packer, you will slice and package ham
• Work in cold/cool temperatures
• You will work in the Oudenaarde area
• You will speak in English, Polish or Ukrainian with your colleagues

AANBOD

• We offer competitive and fair compensation, and there is no mandatory collective leave.
• You can schedule your time off as you wish.
• A quick start is possible.

jobs.description:
Crowne Plaza Brussels Airport is one of Belgium's leading upscale business hotels, ideally located in 

Corporate Village, just minutes from Brussels Airport and NATO headquarters. With 315 stylish guestrooms, 

18 state-of-the-art meeting spaces, newly refreshed extensive meeting- and event facilities and a strong 

international corporate clientele, the hotel is recognized as a premier destination for meetings, conferences 

and business travel. Join a dynamic commercial team where innovation, relationship-building and driving 

results are at the heart of everything we do.
 

Ready to hunt, win and grow?
 

We're looking for a driven Sales Manager who loves opening new doors, building strong client relationships 

and closing deals. This is a true business development role. Your mission is simple: generate new business 

across our Corporate, MICE, Leisure and Airline segments and help position Crowne Plaza Brussels Airport 

as the preferred hotel in the market.
 

What you'll do
 
 

• Hunt for new business opportunities and build your own client portfolio. 

• Negotiate and close commercial agreements. 

• Develop and manage a strong sales pipeline using our CRM. 

• Identify market trends and new business opportunities. 

• Work closely with our commercial and operational teams to deliver outstanding guest 

Who you are
• A natural hunter with a passion for sales.

• A bachelor’s degree
 or equivalent in Hotel Management/Business Administration, 
or equivalent experience.

• Experienced in business development: hospitality experience is a strong advantage.

• Confident negotiator with a results-driven mindset.

• Comfortable working with a CRM and sales targets.

• Fluent in English and either French 
or Dutch.

• Flexible to meet clients and attend events outside standard office hours when required.

Are you detail-oriented and passionate about data, pricing, and ocean freight? 
 

As a Rate Management Specialist, you’ll play a key role in ensuring accurate and efficient pricing processes that power our global operations.
 

You’ll manage customer contracts, tariffs, and costing data across our systems, enabling seamless auto-rating and auto-costing and supporting our journey toward full digitalization.
 

Working closely with commercial, operational, and system teams, you will help deliver tailored pricing solutions that meet customer requirements while supporting ongoing digitalization and process improvement initiatives. This position is essential in maintaining data integrity and optimizing the performance of our global rating platforms.

 
• Strong attention to detail and analytical mindset
 
• Experience in Ocean Freight pricing or operations (minimum 2 years)
 
• Strong communication and collaboration skills
 
• Proficiency in Microsoft 365
 
• Fluent English and Dutch

About the Company

Our client is a leading logistics partner for the frozen food sector, serving industries, retailers, and foodservice companies. The company offers specialized frozen storage, inventory management, and logistics solutions, and is known for its stable operations, strong growth, and focus on employee wellbeing.

Jobomschrijving

Are you a hands-on person who enjoys physical work and thrives in a dynamic warehouse environment? Are you accurate, motivated, and not afraid of working in cold temperatures? Then this opportunity is for you!

For a stable and international logistics company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food storage and distribution, we are looking for motivated Order Pickers to strengthen the team.

Your tasks include:
	
• Picking orders using a voice-picking system or scanner	
• Checking products for quality and quantity	
• Preparing orders for shipment	
• Operating a standing Electric Pallet Truck (EPT)	
• Handling goods in a frozen warehouse environment (-22°C)

We are looking for candidates who:
	
• Have experience as an Order Picker 	
• Have experience operating an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT)	
• Are physically fit and enjoy active work	
• Work accurately and follow instructions carefully	
• Speak English or Dutch	
• Are reliable, motivated, and looking for long-term employment	
• Are comfortable working in a frozen environment (-22°C)

Your Responsibilities

 
• 
 
Unpack, sort, and repack lingerie collections for various pop-up stores.

 
 
• 
 
Handle stock transfers, load and unload goods, and maintain correct stock organization.

 
 
• 
 
Ensure all items are prepared and ready for presentation.

 
 
• 
 
Work schedule: 10:00 to 18:00.

 
 
• 
 
Flexibility is essential — Saturday work is required.

 

 

What We Expect

 
• 
 
Flexible attitude and comfortable working in a dynamic retail and logistics environment.

 
 
• 
 
Willing to travel to different locations; Saturday availability is mandatory.

 
 
• 
 
Driving license B required (own car not needed).

 
 
• 
 
Good command of English.

 
 
• 
 
No previous experience needed — full training is provided.

 
 
• 
 
Detail-oriented and motivated to work with lingerie collections in a professional setting.

We are looking for Motivated Packers of rice cookies!
We are urgently looking for people who can support our client in Zottegem. 

If you know how to tackle things, read on further! 

What are our expectations? 
• You are responsible for packing food products.
• You will keep basic records relating to your workstation.
• You will work in a 2-shift system (Monday to Friday, one week from 06h00 to 14h00 and the next week from 14h00 to 22h00).
• Fine work is not a problem for you.
• You work at a fast pace.
• You have a stable CV and positive references. 
• You are fluent in Dutch or English.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

You’ll be the guardian of data quality making sure the information we rely on is accurate, reliable, and ready to power everything from seamless customer experiences to cutting-edge digital solutions. Think of it as being the detective, the problem-solver, and the strategist all in one, working with teams across the bank to keep our data in top shape.

 

AND IN DETAIL

As a Client Data Quality Analyst, here’s what your day could look like:

• Spot the gaps, fix the flaws. You’ll design and monitor data quality controls, using dashboards to track how well our systems are performing. 
• Turn data into a strategic advantage. You won’t just be fixing problems, you’ll be helping us use data smarter. That could mean:
• Upgrading dashboards so they give clearer, more actionable insights.
• Documenting metadata so everyone understands what our data means and how to use it.
• Supporting data certification and joining key committees to ensure we’re meeting the highest standards.
• Sharing your know-how with the wider Data Quality team, so we all keep getting better.
• Be the bridge between data and real-world impact You’ll get to know our client data flows and applications inside out, becoming the go-to person. Your work will directly help us improve customer experiences, streamline processes, and stay ahead in a fast-changing industry.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

We’re looking for someone who:

•  Loves solving puzzles. You see data as more than numbers; it’s a story waiting to be uncovered. Experience in data quality analysis (especially in banking) is a big plus.
• Speaks “data” fluently. You understand data lifecycles, governance, and how data drives decisions. You’ve done analysis that shows real business impact and you’re passionate about digital transformation.
• Is tech-savvy (but not a coding genius). You’re comfortable with tools like Excel, MS Access, PowerPoint, and Business Objects. If you’ve worked with Collibra, Ab Initio, Tableau, SQL, or Python, even better, but what matters most is your curiosity and willingness to learn.
• Communicates clearly and collaborates easily. You can explain complex ideas in simple terms (in French, Dutch, or English). You’re a team player who enjoys sharing knowledge and learning from others.
• Thrives on challenges. You don’t shy away from tricky problems. Instead, you roll up your sleeves, ask the right questions, and push for solutions that actually work.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL 

The Tribe Artificial Intelligence aims to deliver an efficient and seamless banking experience for our customers and empower our employees through AI. Our expert team of approximately 90 experts includes Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Business Analysts, Scrum Masters, Product Owners and Managers. We are seeking a Data Scientist with a minimum of 3 years of experience in developing AI applications, including both generative and predictive AI. 

 

AND IN DETAIL 

• You develop AI applications to address various business challenges, including virtual assistants to enhance client experiences, advanced AI tools to support employee efficiency and creativity, and automation to optimize internal processes. 
• You use various analytical methods, including large language models (Prompt Engineering, RAG, Fine-tuning), speech-to-text, agentic AI applications, image generation and interpretation, and classical statistical/machine learning techniques. While expertise in all areas is not required, strong proficiency in core technologies and the ability to learn new methods as needed are essential. 
• You contribute to deploying AI applications in production using a comprehensive stack of tools. 
• You access one of the richest volumes of varied data in the market and apply your skills to it. 
• You evolve in an environment where innovation and lean processes are praised, straight-forward communication is encouraged, and peers understand the meaning of team up. 
• You work with a team of colleagues in an Agile organization who are ready to collaborate and to share their experience. 

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES 

• You hold at least a Master’s degree in a quantitative field like statistics, computer science or engineering, with a focus on natural language processing. A PhD is advantageous. Candidates from other academic backgrounds with strong analytics knowledge are also welcome. 
• You have a minimum of 3 years' experience in data science, preferably in the financial sector, though less experience may be accepted if your academic achievements are substantial. 
• You are fluent in English and have a good command of French and/or Dutch. 
• You are proficient in Python for model building and understand ML engineering fundamentals (e.g., versioning systems) to produce code ready for CI/CD integration.
